learningSignals: Seven of 12 automated candidates were rejected as outside OSEG music-programming scope.
Five candidates were deferred; three were inaccessible Booking review permalinks, one was ambiguous house-versus-live music, and one was a cross-platform duplicate.
The corrected discovery queue achieved zero independently accepted guest-review evidence.
Booking review anchors are not reliable operator evidence links; captured source text must be embedded in the review packet.
